subject: Mosaic Labs customer announcement: press timing & quote coordination
messages:
From: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@mosaiclabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: press@mosaiclabs.com
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mosaic & Redwood — press coordination and quote request

Hi Ben,

Hope you’re well — Mosaic is planning a customer announcement in late June and we’d love to include Redwood in the press release and secure a short quote for the launch. We’re aiming for an embargoed release window of June 24, 07:00 ET.

Quick asks:
- Can Redwood provide a 1–2 sentence quote (executive-level) by EOD Friday, 6/12?
- Can you share a high-res Redwood logo and the company blurb for the release?
- We’ll send the draft press release (attached: Mosaic_draft_press_release_v1.pdf) for review.

If June 24 is too tight, please propose an alternate embargo. Our external PR lead (cc’d) can coordinate assets and DocuSign approval.

Thanks,
Sofia Gomez
Director, Communications — Mosaic Labs
sofia.gomez@mosaiclabs.com

Attachment: Mosaic_draft_press_release_v1.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@mosaiclabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mosaic & Redwood — press coordination and quote request

Hi Sofia — thanks for the heads up and congrats to the Mosaic team.

We’re keen to participate. Initial notes:
- June 24 at 07:00 ET is tight for both legal and our marketing team; can we move to June 25, 07:00 ET to give everyone an extra day for approvals?
- We’ll prepare a short, customer-focused quote and send a Redwood blurb + logo.
- Karthik — can you draft a quote we can use as a starting point?
- Marissa — can you coordinate final signoff and asset prep with Sofia’s PR team?

I’ll loop back with an asset bundle by 6/15.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@mosaiclabs.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mosaic & Redwood — press coordination and quote request

Thanks Ben — looping in a draft quote and quick answers to Sofia’s asks.

Draft quote (suggested):
“Redwood Inference is proud to support Mosaic Labs as they bring LLM-powered automation to a broader audience. Their engineering-first approach aligns with our focus on predictable, low-latency inference in production.” — Ben Carter, Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Assets we can provide:
- Redwood one-line blurb (attached: redwood-blurb-v1.docx)
- High-res logo (SVG/PNG) — will circulate by EOD 6/12

Legal note: Please avoid competitive product names in the quote; keep it customer/outcome focused.

Deadline ask: can Mosaic provide the CEO’s one-line approval for quote inclusion by 6/18 so legal can sign off ahead of the embargo?

Karthik
Senior Sales Lead — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@mosaiclabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mosaic & Redwood — press coordination and quote request

Hi all — I’m Redwood’s comms lead on this. Quick coordination notes and a small checklist:

Proposed embargo: June 25, 2026 at 07:00 ET (agreeing with Ben’s ask to move one day).
Needed from Mosaic:
- Final CEO quote (one line) or approval of the drafted customer quote — due 6/18
- High-res Mosaic logos and headshot (for press kit)
- DocuSign link for final usage approval (if possible)

From Redwood side (we will deliver):
- Final one-line customer quote (see Karthik draft) — I’ll refine tone and return by 6/15
- Logo assets and blurb — sending in a single ZIP by 6/15
- Press quote guidance doc attached (press-quote-guidelines.pdf)

Action items:
- Sofia: share final Mosaic press release draft and CEO quote by 6/18
- Ben/Karthik: confirm final quote copy by 6/15
- Marissa: produce final one-line and collate assets (on me)

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 20-min sync for next week if we need to walk through final copy.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Communications — Redwood Inference
Attachment: press-quote-guidelines.pdf

From: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@mosaiclabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mosaic & Redwood — press coordination and quote request

Thanks everyone — agreeing to the timeline and sending final materials.

Updates:
- Mosaic locks embargo to June 25, 2026, 07:00 ET.
- Attached: mosaic_press_final_0620.pdf (final press release) and CEO one-line quote below.
- Small redline request: please remove the phrase “in beta” from Redwood’s draft quote.
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/DocuSign/ApprovalLink?docId=ABC123 — legal approval for quote usage.

CEO quote (for inclusion or for us to approve in your final language):
“Partnering with Redwood Inference helped us reduce real-time inference latency by over 40%, letting Mosaic scale critical workflows with confidence.” — Priya Rangan, CEO, Mosaic Labs

We’ll expect your final quote + logo bundle by COB Monday 6/22 so our PR firm can lock assets with journalists on Tuesday 6/23.

Best,
Sofia
Director, Communications — Mosaic Labs
